textPlacement.assessment: Removing pieces and accepting help remain valid participation, while the Baby removal context and later Toddler fitting examples remain visibly distinct.
The age variants preserve repeated exploration and optional help while keeping earlier fitting materials distinct from later matching and opening examples.
The older placement keeps sorting observational and untested, with supervised objects distinguished from ordinary clothing tasks and the later button photograph.
Both placements invite the child’s own marks and optional conversation without expecting a recognizable picture or an age-based achievement.
The contexts retain supervision and standing readiness while separating earlier chalk and easel work from later watercolor exploration.
The contexts preserve supervised experimentation and partial repetition while making gluing a distinct later example within the younger band.
Prepared materials and flexible ways to keep work support family capacity, with independent gathering around three clearly left as later context.
